description: Send a branded TaScan task notification email via SendGrid. Can notify anyone about a specific task list or task. Includes QR code, task summary, and "Open in TaScan" button.

include_qr.description: Include QR code for the task list in the email (default: true)

message.description: Optional custom message to include in the email body

task_id.description: Optional specific task ID to highlight

name: tascan_send_task_email
